    • getPendingCraftingJobOutput

      @Nullable protected PendingCraftingJobOutput<T> getPendingCraftingJobOutput(ITerminalStorageTabClient tab, int channel, @Nullable String label)
      Get the pending output of the running crafting jobs that will produce this slot's instance.
      Parameters:
      tab - The tab this slot is being rendered in.
      channel - The channel this slot is being rendered in.
      label - An optional label that is rendered instead of the quantity. Slots with such a label are not part of the storage overview, such as the instance that is being moved around by the player, so they don't get a crafting indication.
      Returns:
      The pending crafting job output, or null if this slot's instance is not being crafted.
